verdict.rationale: Termius documents a built-in AI feature that turns plain-language descriptions into shell commands (termius-docs-6, termius-docs-45), so users can drive terminal work with natural language. Nothing shows natural language controlling the product itself, such as connecting to hosts, managing vaults, or running workflows. Missing for 10: natural-language control of app functions beyond shell-command generation, agentic multi-step execution, depth of docs on the AI feature, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
